description: TypeError comparing offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes in active dasha lookup
root_cause: datetime.fromisoformat() produces naive datetime while ref_dt may have tzinfo (e.g. UTC)
remediation: Normalize both ref_dt and period boundaries to UTC before interval containment checks

description: Silent fallback to birth dasha dashas[0] when ref_dt is not in nominal range
root_cause: Fallback branch unconditionally assigns dashas[0] without checking whether ref_dt is future or pre-natal
remediation: Return explicit status flag (EXPIRED or PRE_NATAL) or out-of-range indicators rather than silently claiming birth dasha

description: Engineering report text example showed Antardasha ending August 2026 declared active at ref_date October 2026
root_cause: Documentation example pasted illustrative payload without updating sample response body to match 2026-10-31 date
remediation: Correct report narrative and fixtures to use verified astronomical dates for reference instant

description: Hardcoded +5.5 hours UTC offset in TypeScript AstroCalculator fallback
root_cause: Local calculateChart assumed Indian Standard Time (+5:30) without dynamic timezone parameter
remediation: Accept explicit tz_offset parameter and resolve UTC hours dynamically

description: Ephemeris file source not explicitly declared in metadata (FLG_MOSEPH vs FLG_SWIEPH)
root_cause: swe.calc_ut without ephe files defaults to Moshier analytical model without informing client
remediation: Inspect iflag from swe.calc_ut and expose ephemeris_source explicitly in metadata

description: Kantaka Shani and Ardhashtama Shani nomenclature conflation across lineages
root_cause: Classical traditions differ on whether Kantaka is 4th/8th or 10th/7th/4th
remediation: Expose configurable methodology setting and label 4th house as Ardhashtama / Kantaka with explicit source citation

description: Polar and high-latitude locations fail standard sunrise/sunset division
root_cause: Swiss Ephemeris rise_trans can fail at extreme latitudes during midnight sun or polar night
remediation: Add high-latitude fallback using civil twilight or 24 equal seasonal hours with explicit metadata flag

description: Swiss Ephemeris AGPL v3 vs Commercial License requirement for closed-source SaaS
root_cause: pyswisseph bundles Swiss Ephemeris C-library which requires AGPL or commercial license from Astrodienst AG
remediation: Document licensing audit findings and provide release guidance for platform owner

description: Division boundary edge cases at sign cusps (e.g. exactly 0.00° or 29.999°)
root_cause: Floating point precision can cause boundary rollover inconsistencies
remediation: Apply epsilon clamping and explicit boundary test matrix across all 16 Shodashavarga charts

description: AI narrative generation previously claimed 'Zero Hallucination' without epistemic boundaries
root_cause: Marketing claims could mislead users into believing astrology outcomes are scientifically guaranteed
remediation: Rebrand certification to 'Deterministic Calculation and Narrative Validation' and enforce probabilistic language
